infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Petal uses the camera so you can take photos of your pets, scan a caregiver invite code, and capture vet documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Petal needs access to your photos so you can add pet pictures and attach health records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Petal saves pet photos and health documents you export back to your library.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Petal uses the microphone when you record a video of your pet.
